location: D-L, 1885 ; [acc/ Kinsky 1913 : 198, it is Heye, Cologne, #1885, ca. 1740, in E-flat.]
signature: "MACHT IOHANN LEONHARD / EHE = IN = NVRNBERG"; maker's mark: Turk's head with initials "I L" and "E"; owner's mark(?): "V.O." in an oval. PITCH: E-flat at a1 = 440 (Kammerton-pitch)
mouthpiece: Prussian cornet mp, probably Vogtland manufacture, 3rd quarter of 19c. Inside diam. of bowl 17, throat 4.6, outlet 9.2, depth of bowl 16.5, total length 67.3.
dimensions: bo 9.5, be 99.5, le 2045, int. diam. of mouthpipe 11.9. (Myers A 1998 gives be 100.)
remarks: Loud, rather trumpet-like sound.²6 pos.; bell at 4th pos.; flat bell-stay; tubular slide-stays; Nuremberg-style rim-wire; engraved garland; inside of bell painted black (original); pattern of raised shells at top of garland; very good condition. Detailed measurements of bore and graph showing bore profile in Myers A 1998.
